reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 - separate AI source reviewer; not a human review

reviewScope.summary: Independent AI review of bounded two-worker Vitest configuration and aligned repository guidance.
evidence: Reviewed owner-supplied Git diff and local implementation transcript, alongside repository release-control source.
Candidate verification checks require exactly four modified files and the expected two commits based on bc622986.
Local seven-file pilot: 173 tests passed with one worker and two workers; measured wall times 226.9 s and 111.6 s.
One complete local two-worker run: 214/214 files and 3644/3644 tests passed, wall time 884.9 s.
Reported focused Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and diff checks passed; no residual new Node processes remained after final checks.
Hosted stability and performance have not been tested. This review did not independently execute the test suite.

adversarialFindings.description: Concurrent test files could interfere through shared resources or memory contention.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Worker count is capped at two, file isolation remains explicit, and all local tests passed. Hosted FULL must verify the actual runner.

adversarialFindings.description: The previous unconstrained Windows worker model leaked processes.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The new configuration explicitly caps workers at two; the observed local run ended without residual new Node processes.

adversarialFindings.description: Local timing measurements do not prove a hosted CI improvement.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The pilot improvement is reported as local only. Hosted FULL timing and resource observations remain required before merge.

adversarialFindings.description: Old repository instructions contradicted the revised worker configuration.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The candidate updates AGENTS.md and docs/ci.md to describe bounded, isolated concurrency.

retrospective.summary: Scoped independent AI source review permits one ordinary hosted PR evaluation. Production acceptance and hosted performance benefit are not established.
